description: Is this firm barred from federal contracts or assistance? Searches SAM.gov's active exclusions (debarments, suspensions, other bars) of firms with a Texas address by name, including firms no longer on Texas state lists. Each result has the excluding agency, exclusion type, active and end dates, sam_record (UEI, CAGE code, how to verify), name_score, match_reasons, a verification label, and the linked entity_id when Trudex can tie it to a Texas taxpayer (link.tier strong: same name and street address; possible: name only). status is match (same name), possible or not_found. A name match is not proof of identity: unless verification says otherwise, treat a result as "Name match only. Not verified to be this entity." and confirm by UEI on SAM.gov. not_found is not a clearance. Exclusions of individuals are not covered. Refreshed daily from SAM.gov. Requires a signed-in caller (token or OAuth). Example: {"name": "Green Diesel", "city": "Houston"}.

city.description: Texas city, e.g. "Houston". Orders results; does not filter.

zip.description: ZIP code. Orders results; does not filter.
